display.purpose: Home intro name and one primary title per fold.

body.purpose: Intro paragraphs, essay prose, project descriptions. Max 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Dates beside writing entries and secondary metadata.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Link color and underline transitions only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary brown fill for contact or subscribe actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #BFA28C; color: #2c3028; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: Satoshi, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A38872; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #BFA28C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Default inline link using dark olive for contrast.
components.css: .ds-link { color: #464f41; font-family: Satoshi, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-link:hover { color: #383f34; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #BFA28C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Writing List Row
components.html: 17.Apr.2026Taste Can't Be Prompted
components.css: .ds-writing-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px 16px; padding: 8px 0; font-family: Satoshi, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-writing-date { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #5a6352; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-writing-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2c3028; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-writing-title:hover { color: #464f41; }

components.name: Work Entry
components.description: Project line with name and short descriptor.
components.html: Peerlist/ Professional network for builders
components.css: .ds-work-entry { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; padding: 6px 0; font-family: Satoshi, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-work-name { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2c3028; text-decoration: none; } .ds-work-name:hover { color: #464f41; } .ds-work-desc { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: #5a6352; }

components.name: Section Headline
components.description: Plain section header without eyebrow kicker.
components.css: .ds-section-headline { font-family: Satoshi, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #2c3028; margin: 0 0 16px 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Newsletter or contact field if added later.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; max-width: 20rem; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: Satoshi, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #2c3028; background: #f4f6f0; border: 1px solid #d6dbd0; border-radius: 4px; transition: outline 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5a6352; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #BFA28C; outline-offset: 0; border-color: #BFA28C; }

narrative.overview: This system treats the site as a narrow column of ink on paper: one voice, one measure, no decorative scaffolding. The color world is olive with primary brown #BFA28C for brand fills and dark olive for readable link text.
keyCharacteristics: Narrow reading measure (~42rem) centered on the page
Olive neutral scale with primary brown #BFA28C
Flat surfaces: no drop shadows at rest
Bilingual-ready type stack (Satoshi + IBM Plex Sans Thai)
Lists over cards; dates beside titles, not inside tiles

rules.name: The Primary Brown Rule
rules.body: #BFA28C is the sole primary brand color. Use it on filled controls, selection highlights, and focus outlines. Do not substitute a different tan or gold.

rules.name: The Olive Ground Rule
rules.body: Page and surface neutrals stay on the olive hue axis (olive-50 through olive-300). Gray blues and warm cream defaults are out of register.

rules.name: The Contrast Split Rule
rules.body: Brown primary for brand fills; dark olive for link text. Never set #BFA28C as default body or link color on olive-50.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Satoshi carries display through label roles. Do not add a reflex display serif or monospace accent font.

rules.name: The Margin Measure Rule
rules.body: Prose and profile content stay within max-width: 42rem. Wider only for full-bleed photography when imagery ships.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If a section needs separation, add space or a hairline rule. Never reach for a card shadow to create hierarchy.

dos: Do use the olive scale (text-olive-600, bg-olive-50, etc.) for neutrals.
Do use #BFA28C as primary on buttons, selection, and focus rings.
Do use dark olive (olive-700 / accent) for link text on light backgrounds.
Do keep the home structure as intro → work → writing.
Do use Satoshi + IBM Plex Sans Thai for all text roles.
donts: Don't use #BFA28C for body copy or default links on olive-50 (fails contrast).
Don't revert to cool blue-gray ink or navy link colors from the previous palette.
Don't ship SaaS landing-page grammar or dark-mode dev portfolio clichés.
Don't add side-stripe borders, gradient text, or glassmorphism cards.
Don't repeat tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows above every section heading.
Don't add a third display typeface from the reflex-reject list.
